what.text: This page follows people from Venezuela in Curacao whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6903 Venezuelan people in need of international protection in Curacao, 0.1% of all people in need of international protection from Venezuela.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2023.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group start in 2018 at their highest point, 25686.
The figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Curacao.
These are year-end totals for Curacao only, and the group is never added to refugees.
